candidate.claim: The fractal-string proposal interprets zeta as the transfer factor from geometric lengths to harmonic frequencies and seeks to realize s to 1-s symmetry by a dual continuum string.
candidate.proposed_limit: The proposed complex measures are not constructed, and the defining pole condition imports the zeros it aims to represent.
candidate.title: Functional equation as dual counting representation

parents.context_note: The opening Epstein-zeta and brane discussion is motivational; the reusable core begins with the counting-function dictionary.
parents.representation_dependency: High; Dirichlet series and pole calculation are formula dependent.
parents.selection_reason: Defines geometric and frequency counting functions, explains the factorization ZF equals ZL times zeta, and uses the Cantor string to show how poles of the length series encode complex dimensions.
parents.title: Fractal-string lengths and harmonic frequencies factor through zeta

accepted_interpretation.interpretation: The factorization separates geometry from harmonic repetition: ZL records the base scales, while ζ records the universal integer overtones. Singularities of the geometric factor become a compact representation of scaling dimension and oscillation.
accepted_interpretation.nonparaphrase_operation: The counting-function factorization is the bridge from a multiset of lengths to a spectrum. It preserves the separation between source geometry and repeated-frequency structure.
accepted_interpretation.quality_reason: The source explicitly defines the geometric and frequency counting series, derives ZF=ZL times zeta, and computes the Cantor-string pole lattice with real part log 2 over log 3. The output correctly separates this factorization from the source's speculative quantum-gravity interpretation.
accepted_interpretation.source_support: The source defines ZL(s)=Σ lj^s and the double frequency sum ZF(s), obtaining ZF(s)=ζ(s)ZL(s). For the Cantor string, lengths 3^(−n) with multiplicities 2^n give a geometric series whose poles have real part log 2/log 3 and periodically spaced imaginary parts.
accepted_interpretation.speculation_status: The physical interpretation of complex dimensions and the connection to quantum gravity are proposals, not consequences of the factorization. Poles must not be confused with ζ-zeros or with proof of RH. The Cantor-string calculation is explicit, though several superscripts and denominators are extraction-sensitive. Describing zeta as the universal integer-overtone factor and the geometric series as the base-scale factor is a faithful interpretation of the double sum. Some superscripts and denominators are degraded, but the factorization and Cantor geometric-series mechanism remain legible.

parents.context_note: Existence of the required maps and measures is asserted only in principle; defining the string by the target zeros is not an independent derivation of them.
parents.representation_dependency: Very high; continuum integral definitions and the ratio are central.
parents.selection_reason: Replaces discrete lengths and frequencies by continuum complex-valued maps and measures, proposes zeta as their ratio, and defines a Riemann fractal string by poles of its geometric counting function at zeta zeros.
parents.title: Continuum complex measures proposed to realize zeta and its functional-equation dual

accepted_interpretation.interpretation: Moving to continuum complex measures expands the representational freedom enough to imitate functional-equation duality. That flexibility also weakens explanatory force unless existence, regularity, and independence from the desired zeros are established.
accepted_interpretation.nonparaphrase_operation: The ratio of two Mellin-like integrals is the proposed bridge from a generalized string to ζ; conjugate length, frequency, and measure data are intended to encode the duality.
accepted_interpretation.quality_reason: The span proposes continuum complex-valued length and frequency maps and measures, defines zeta as a ratio of their integrals, and defines a Riemann fractal string through poles at zeta zeros. The output correctly says existence is only claimed in principle and that defining the object by the desired zero set does not derive that set.
accepted_interpretation.source_support: The source introduces continuum integrals for geometric and frequency counting functions using complex-valued maps and measures, proposes ZF/ZL=ζ and a dual relation under s↦1−s, and defines a Riemann fractal string whose geometric counting function has simple poles at zeta zeros.
accepted_interpretation.speculation_status: The required maps and measures are only said to be obtainable in principle. Defining the object by the target zeros is circular as a route to locating them, and a pole/zero alternative in a ratio needs noncancellation assumptions. This unit is explicitly speculative and formula-dependent; it establishes a proposed representation, not existence or a theorem about RH. The noncancellation caution for interpreting a zero of a ratio as a numerator zero or denominator pole is a mathematically reasonable missing hypothesis diagnosis. The construction is explicitly speculative and the dense continuum formulas are extraction-sensitive, but the proposal's conditional status is clear.
